get.summary: Read the exact Analysis Report bytes for an owned Run
get.description: Require the authenticated owning principal and current run:read permission for the selected Run. Only a directly registered, retained artifact of kind normalized and format analysis-result/v1 qualifies. Unknown, foreign and ineligible associations return the same scoped 404. After authorization and binding, advertised oversize returns 422. Verify bounded original bytes, size, SHA-256, schema and Run linkage before returning 200. Read failure, actual overflow or failed verification returns 503 without partial bytes. Apply the exact-byte HTTP profile in docs/run-evidence-reads.md#run-owned-analysis-report-content.
